description:
Subsidised housing in the Twin Cities metro and the date each subsidy runs out. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Which affordable housing subsidies expire before 2031?"
- "Subsidised buildings near 900 Selby Ave, Saint Paul?"

address.description: A street address inside the seven-county metro, to answer about ONE property instead of the whole market. Include the city after a comma when the street name is common — 'Grand Ave' exists in several of these cities.

cut.description: expiring: subsidy ends before 2031; all: every subsidised property; ended: subsidy ended by 2026-09-30; large: 50 or more subsidised units. Default expiring.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: expiring_affordable_housing
title: Expiring Affordable Housing
